doan_van.noi_dung: A greedy Squirrel prepares a big nut feast for his friends. A patient Turtle carries the heavy food slowly toward the garden. The weather suddenly changes and heavy rain starts to fall. They quickly decide to eat inside a dry cave instead. The friends enjoy their simple meal together in the shelter. Patience turns a bad situation into a good plan. Good plans often require flexible minds.

mini_story.ten: Ngụ ngôn - Bữa tiệc thay đổi của Sóc và Rùa
mini_story.truyen: A greedy Squirrel prepares a big nut feast for his friends. A patient Turtle carries the heavy food slowly toward the garden. The weather suddenly changes and heavy rain starts to fall. They quickly decide to eat inside a dry cave instead. The friends enjoy their simple meal together in the shelter. Patience turns a bad situation into a good plan. Good plans often require flexible minds.

mini_story.truyen: Nam grabs a big bowl of red hair dye to help his mother. He carefully applies the thick liquid over her entire head. The kitchen smells like a chemical factory.
